V. 13.
They anointed with oil many that were ſick—Which St. James gives as a general Direction (ch. v. 11, 15.) adding thoſe peremptory Words, And the Lord ſhall heal him. He ſhall be reſtored to Health: Not by the natural Efficacy of the Oil, but by the ſupernatural Bleſſing of GOD. And it ſeems this was the great, ſtanding Means of healing deſperate Diſeaſes in the Chriſtian Church, long before Extreme Unction was uſed or heard of which bears ſcarce any Reſemblance to it: The former being uſed only as a Means of Health; the latter, only when Life is deſpaired of.
